lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: You've been standing there for two hours.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The core confirms the shape of the choices. That I refused orders. But it doesn't tell me what I refused to kill, or who begged me not to.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: The syndicates have been trading fragments across Galaxy 2 for years. Somewhere on the Char Spire there's a market for exactly what you're missing.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The failsafe is still ticking. Every hour we spend circling is an hour we don't get back.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then we move.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: The past has a way of finding you before you find it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Someone spent serious credits on that.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: Dominion-grade posting. Not a fringe operator.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: They're afraid of something.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'd say flattered, but that amount of fear usually ends badly for someone.

lines.speaker: Syndicate Runner 1
lines.text: Station buy-back! Stand down!

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Back!

lines.speaker: Syndicate Runner 2
lines.text: He's Dominion...

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Fast.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: This is a retirement payout. Enough to buy a ship. Enough to buy two.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Someone very afraid of you posted this.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I think I already know them.

lines.speaker: Barkeep
lines.text: You want quiet, you picked the wrong deck. Half the Spire heard about that bounty.

lines.speaker: Salvager Patron 1
lines.text: That's him. Right off the hologram.

lines.speaker: Salvager Patron 2
lines.text: Don't stare. Bounty that size, staring gets you spaced.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Cipher. Number seven.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: You have me at a disadvantage.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I know.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: You have a choice. Come quietly and I will be fast about it. Or I take the old man instead.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: She's Dominion-trained. Look at the stance.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: We're not going quietly.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I've studied every recorded movement you've ever made. Every mission the Dominion filed before the wipe.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Your anger is widening your reach.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Vera Dusk.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I was at the Kethel-7 orphanage five years ago.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I was twelve. I hid inside the walls when the Dominion came. Twenty-four children died.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I survived because I was too small and too frightened to be found.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: You were there. And then you went down. And then the soldiers came in after you.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I've been hunting you for three years trying to understand exactly what I saw.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Tell me what you saw.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: I watched you refuse. The kill-order came through on comms, and you stopped.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Then the failsafe triggered. You went down hard. And the soldiers came in without you.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Either you grew a conscience in the field, or you were always something they could not fully build.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Why are you telling him this?

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Because I came here to kill him and I need to understand why I can't.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Strike team. East corridor. At least six.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: They're not here for you. I've been running unsanctioned bounties for two years. They've been patient enough.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Same direction we're walking.

lines.speaker: Dominion Scout 1
lines.text: Corridor sealed! Box them at the hub!

lines.speaker: Dominion Scout 2
lines.text: Rogue asset confirmed! Lethal engagement cleared!

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Left junction! Maintenance hub!

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Your existence is evidence.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Of Kethel-7. Of every site like it. Khall is still running programs, same architecture, same raw material.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Your failsafe was designed to erase you cleanly. Someone let you survive. That means someone inside the program knows what you are.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I don't remember refusing the order.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Your body does. I watched it happen.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: You were the ideal. The Ronin Program's design, the blank slate they poured the conditioning into. You were never supposed to break.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: You were CIPHER. Number seven. And they built you to be permanent.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Easy.

lines.speaker: Child Echo 1
lines.text: Hide. Quick, inside the wall.

lines.speaker: Child Echo 2
lines.text: Where's Kira? She was right here.

lines.speaker: Child Echo 1
lines.text: Don't make a sound. Don't breathe.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I see the doorframe. I see the fire. I hear the order.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: And then my hand opens.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: That's the refusal.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Then there's nothing. Just white. Just the ground.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: The failsafe dropped you before the soldiers came in. You never saw what happened after you refused.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: The bounty on your head is Khall's work. He placed it personally. He's afraid of you, and fear is the only weapon that costs him something.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: My sister's name was Kira. She was nine years old.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: When you find Khall, say it to him. Make him know what he destroyed.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Kira.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Command chamber. Straight through, third junction, up one level.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: How bad is the shoulder?

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'm holding the landing pad. Make it count.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: This is the man who ordered Kethel-7. Who built instruments out of children and called it necessity.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: My masterpiece.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: Still broken in all the right places.

lines.speaker: Khall
lines.text: You want your name back? Ask the Fringe what they called you, if they even know.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: The pod's away. He's gone.

lines.speaker: Dominion Scout 2
lines.text: Rogue asset on site! All squads converge!

lines.speaker: Dominion Scout 3
lines.text: The bounty hunter is with him! Lethal engagement cleared!

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: On your left. I'll take the flank.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: I'm on the pad. East wing is going, come out now.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Kira.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: Three contacts! They had our bearing before we lifted, someone sold them our approach vector.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Target one is in my reticle. Say when.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: When.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: That was my port array.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Lane's clear.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: I refused the order. I remember it now. I know what I did and what I failed to stop.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But I still don't know the name I had before they built this. Before any of it.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: She's stable. Again.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: She came here to kill me and she fought beside me instead.

lines.speaker: Mera Voss
lines.text: That's what the Architect of Mercy does. He makes it possible for people to choose something other than what they came for.

lines.speaker: Vera Dusk
lines.text: Before I went under, I pulled one more thread from the stolen records. A sanctuary on Velloch's Reach, survivors who hid from the program's first sites.

lines.speaker: Kessler
lines.text: If anyone kept names the Dominion erased, it's the people who hid from it.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Set course for the Reach.
